headline: The duel now gets the music
lede: Prince of Persia's soundtrack used to flinch on every sword clash. It now lays back for the whole exchange and returns when the steel goes quiet — and for the first time the duck is measured in a real browser, not just the mix model.

notes.text: PRINCE OF PERSIA: a held duel duck — the bed ducks once when a fight starts, holds ~1.4 s past the last hit, then glides back up. No more per-clash pumping (#2667).

popcheck 404/404 pins the exchange law (engage/extend/release, resets never inherit a duck); popplay now asserts the duck-over-bed drop on the live analyser, closing the last honest gap on the sound spine.
PLAICRAFT #1711: store sweep clean — every machine-side acceptance line verified again; what's left is one clap take from Jon's phone (the coach and nightly grader are armed and waiting).
